long_biography.plain_text:
Heran Building Group grew from a family housebuilding tradition into an integrated residential developer across Queensland. Martin Christopher Heran and his brothers managed the business, while Martin also controlled a building company within the wider family structure. The group's model spans land acquisition, planning, construction and completed home sales rather than contracting on other developers' sites.

Heran's role sits within a multigenerational enterprise rather than a sole-founder story. He remains a partner in a Queensland property partnership and holds an active low-rise builder licence. Outside property, he and his brother Glenn operated Heran Racing Stable; their mare Pippie won two Group 1 races before a high-profile broodmare sale.
